body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Noritsu America Corporation showcased its double-side retail photo printer 'D502' at CES 2009.

This compact inkjet printer can provide high quailty duplex printing with a versatility that maximizes revenue potential. The D502 enables users to create photobooks, greeting cards, enlargements, calendars and even panoramic posters.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
